name: android-device-console
description: Live Android device console: UI-state toggles, Doze and standby controls, WorkManager job runner, and the device state in the system prompt.

package.title: Application id
package.description: The app's applicationId for Doze buckets and jobs. Left empty, it is read from app/build.gradle(.kts).

pollSeconds.title: Refresh period (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often device state is re-read when $.process is available. 0 turns polling off. Never polls through the Bash tool.
